name: Machine T-Bar Row
steps: Lie chest-down on a T-bar row machine with your feet planted firmly on the footplates and grasp either the wide or neutral handles firmly.
Lift the lever off its rest so your arms hang straight down with a slight stretch across your upper back.
Pull the handles smoothly up toward your chest by driving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades tightly together.
Straighten your arms under control and return the lever to its rest when you finish.
tips: Keep your chest glued to the support pad instead of lifting up to heave heavier loads.
Keep your neck neutral and avoid shrugging your shoulders toward your ears.
